pipeline_params.description: Tirtha by Spanda Works (tirtha.ai): an OpenAI-compatible gateway in auto mode. A small model answers first; a second model and a yes/no checker compare answers, and the request climbs to a larger model only when the check fails. The served model is the routing choice. Router-side calls (the second opinion and the checker) are recorded in router_usage. SETUP: Tirtha 1.0 as served in production on 2026-11-10. The second-opinion and checker calls in router_usage are estimated from measured averages, as stated per row.
